item.title: Fairfield mayor joins District 3 Board of Supervisors race
item.description: Fairfield Mayor Catherine “Cat” Moy announced Friday that she has filed to run for the District 3 seat on the Solano County Board of Supervisors this year against incumbent Solano County Supervisor Wanda Williams. Moy said she decided to enter the race after consulting with her family and thinking and praying on the matter. item.title: Vacaville vendors turn out for vets
item.description: The Vacaville Veterans Hall hosted its third annual Spring-In Craft and Resource Fair on Saturday, offering local vendors a chance to showcase their wares and raising funds for the Sacramento Valley National Cemetery’s Avenue of Flags. Nel Sweet-Davis, organizer of the event, said the avenue of flags lines the entryway to the cemetery. item.title: Local Roundup: Bethel boys volleyball wins fourth straight match
item.description: Boys Volleyball Bethel 3, Kennedy 0 The Bethel High boys volleyball team swept Kennedy on Friday, winning 25-6, 25-22 and 25-9. The Jaguars were led by Antonio Lee, who had nine kills. Justin Remoquillo had 20 assists and Joshua Vicente had five kills. With the win Bethel improved to 4-2 with its fourth straight win. […]
